question: Now only for 2024.

priorTurns.question: Show total revenue by region.
priorTurns.sql: SELECT s.Region, SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Orders AS o ON o.OrderId = ol.OrderId JOIN dbo.Stores AS s ON s.StoreId = o.StoreId GROUP BY s.Region ORDER BY s.Region

referenceSql: SELECT s.Region, SUM(ol.Quantity * ol.UnitPrice * (1 - ol.Discount)) AS TotalRevenue FROM dbo.OrderLines AS ol JOIN dbo.Orders AS o ON o.OrderId = ol.OrderId JOIN dbo.Stores AS s ON s.StoreId = o.StoreId JOIN dbo.Calendar AS cal ON cal.[Date] = o.OrderDate WHERE cal.[Year] = 2024 GROUP BY s.Region ORDER BY s.Region
